meta.note: Global AV leaders and country comparison. Deployments change fast — every company row must be re-verified at use time. This layer answers: what does the world do now, and what does it imply for South Africa?

leaders.name: Waymo
leaders.oddc: Geofenced US metros (San Francisco, Phoenix, LA, Austin); Jaguar I-PACE / Zeekr
leaders.note: Largest commercial robotaxi fleets by miles; benchmark for safety metrics reporting.
leaders.saImplication: No near-term SA entry; its disengagement/safety-reporting model is a template for any SA operator.

leaders.name: Tesla
leaders.oddc: Vision-based, wide ODD consumer rollout; US/Europe/China markets
leaders.note: FSD supervised release; scale of data advantage enormous.
leaders.saImplication: ADAS penetration in SA private cars is the likely first autonomous feature (verify local fitment/features approval).

leaders.name: Mobileye
leaders.note: Camera-first stack powering many OEMs (incl. via VW group globally).
leaders.saImplication: Likely invisible enabler inside imported/local-built SA vehicles.

leaders.name: NVIDIA
leaders.note: Compute + simulation backbone for most stacks.
leaders.saImplication: Compute availability gated by exports; simulation tooling accessible.

leaders.name: Aurora
leaders.saImplication: Template for N3/N1 long-haul if SA regulation opens.

leaders.name: Kodiak Robotics
leaders.note: Expansion into Australia (mining/off-road) is a direct analogue signal for SA.

leaders.name: Torc Robotics
leaders.saImplication: Mercedes/Daimler ecosystem reach may carry tech into SA later.

leaders.name: Wayve
leaders.saImplication: Watch for licensing/validation models suitable for chaotic environments.

leaders.name: Waabi
leaders.oddc: US hub-to-hub; Waabi Driver closed-loop sim
leaders.saImplication: Simulation-centric validation model aligned with our scenario approach.

leaders.name: Pony.ai
leaders.saImplication: Chinese stacks may target African pilot programs aggressively.

leaders.name: Baidu Apollo
leaders.oddc: China volume robotaxis (Apollo Go) + open-source stack
leaders.saImplication: Affordable open-stack option for research pilots (Apollo Open).

leaders.name: Cruise
leaders.note: Setback case study in regulatory/operational risk.
leaders.saImplication: Caution lesson; safety case must precede speed.

leaders.name: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE Pilot
leaders.oddc: Germany (then global) motorway L3 at speed
leaders.note: First certified L3 on sale (DRIVE Pilot, 2022+).
leaders.saImplication: L3 highway tech will arrive in SA vehicles as imported features; legality local must be tracked.

leaders.name: Hyundai/Kia
leaders.note: Hyundai Group heavy in L2+/L3 volume tech.

leaders.name: Volvo
leaders.saImplication: Freight autonomy supplier for future SA corridors.

leaders.name: Caterpillar / Komatsu
leaders.saImplication: SA mining is the most immediate autonomy market; engage via these OEM ecosystems.
